title: PH58014: Magnetism
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Magnetism in dilute system, ligand field and orbital moment quenching,
magnetism of interacting system , direct and indirect exchange interaction,
mean field theory of ferro- anti-ferro- and ferri- magnet, spin wave and its
interaction, itinerant magnetism, Hubbard model, spin density wave, spin
fluctuation, magnetic resonance, magnetic anisotropy and domain, review of
experimental results on low and high T_c superconductor, thermodynamics and
phenomenological theory, electron-phonon interaction, Cooper pair, BCS theory,
ground state, energy gap, transition temperature, flux quantization, GL theory.
Tunneling and Josephson effect, superconducting devices.
